Description
Onion Shampoo has strong ayurvedic herbs that help stop hair from falling out, keep dandruff under control, and stop hair from turning grey too soon. Onion extract, kalonji seed oil, jatamansi, neem oil, bhringraj, and keshya herbs are all in this product to make your hair healthier and stronger. Works well for everyday use without being harsh.
How to Use
• Apply an adequate amount of shampoo to wet hair and scalp
• Massage gently to create a rich lather.
• Leave on for 2–3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with water
• Rinse thoroughly and repeat if necessary.
Key Features
• Helps reduce premature greying of hair
• Controls dandruff and soothes itchy scalp
• Strengthens roots to reduce hair fall
• Enriched with onion extract and ayurvedic herbs
• Nourishes scalp and improves hair vitality
• 2× more effective ayurvedic proprietary formula

Onion Extract, Kalonji Seed Oil , Jatamansi , Neem Oil

Absolutely — it does not strip colour or moisture.

Yes, it cleans the scalp effectively without over-drying.

Description
Discover clearer, blemish-free skin with our Blemished Facewash, enriched with the healing power of green tea and refreshing mandarin extract. Its deep pore cleansing action lifts away impurities, reduces dark spots, and gently fades blemishes to reveal a brighter, more even-toned complexion. With every wash, your skin feels purified, refreshed, and naturally radiant, making it perfect for daily use. This antioxidant-rich formula helps revive dull skin while supporting a healthier, smoother texture. Ideal for anyone seeking a clean, calm, and glowing look every day.
How to Use
Apply a small amount on damp face, massage gently in circular motions, and rinse thoroughly. Use twice daily for best results.
Key Features
•Clears up any build-up for healthier and smoother skin.
•Gives a hydrated ,soft,and supple skin.
•Sweeps away dry and dead skin cells
•Targets blemishes & uneven pigmentation
•Reduces melanin deposit

Description
Blemish-End Cream is a powerful anti-blemish treatment enriched with green tea and mandarin extract. It helps reduce dark spots, lighten blemishes, minimize melanin production, and improve uneven skin tone. Ideal for blemish-prone and pigmented skin, this lightweight formula promotes a clearer, brighter, and healthier complexion with regular use.
How to Use
1.Wash your face with lukewarm water and pat dry.
2.Apply the Aaryanveda Blemish-End cream on your face and neck.
3.Use fingertips to apply the cream in a circular motion then rub gently till the cream absorbs into the skin.
4.Apply twice a day to get brighter blemish-free skin.
Key Features
1.Reduces Dark Spots & Blemishes for visibly clearer skin
2.Minimizes Melanin Production to prevent new pigmentation
3.Improves Skin Tone & Clarity with natural antioxidants
4.Soothes & Calms blemish-prone skin
5.Lightweight & Fast-Absorbing daily use formula
Ingredients
Green Tea ,Mandarin Extract,Orange Extract, Arbutin
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What does Blemish-End Cream do?
Targets blemish-prone skin for clearer, more even tone.
Can it reduce spots and marks?
Yes — with regular use it helps reduce appearance of spots.
Who should use it?
Best for blemish-prone or uneven skin.
How often should I apply it?
Use as part of daily skincare routine.
Can makeup be applied over it?
Yes — suitable for layering under makeup.

Description
Rice Water & Niacinamide 10% Serum is a powerful skincare solution that helps to improve the overall appearance and health of your skin. This serum contains natural rice water extract and niacinamide, which work together to hydrate, brighten, and soothe your skin. The serum has a lightweight and non-greasy texture that gets easily absorbed into your skin, leaving it feeling fresh and revitalised.
How to Use
• Apply 3-5 drops of Glowelle Rice Water & Niacinamide 10% Serum on the entire face and neck.
(twice a day) in an upward circular motion.
• Massage using fingertips until the serum gets absorbed.
• During the day, follow it up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen moisturizer .
• Use continuously for 6 to 8 weeks for noticeable results.
Key Features
•Hydrates and moisturizes your skin
•Brightens and evens out your skin tone
•Soothes irritated skin and reduces redness
•Minimizes the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
•Improves skin texture and elasticity
Ingredients
Rice water, Niacinamide,Hyaluronic acid , Aloevera Extract.

Description
Kumkumadi Oil for face and skin is a formulation of traditional ingredients widely used in ayurvedic oil for the face. Its natural ingredients help brighten the skin, improve texture and glow, and minimise scars and acne. The oil being rich in antioxidants helps in improving skin complexion and reducing dark circles. It is very helpful in reducing blemishes.
How to Use
𝐇𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐨 𝐔𝐬𝐞:
• Take a few drops of the oil on your palms.
• Gently massage the oil onto cleansed face and neck using upward motions.
• Leave it on overnight for best results.
• Use daily for visible improvements in skin texture and radiance.
Key Features
𝐁𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐟𝐢𝐭𝐬:
𝟏. 𝐄𝐧𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐬 𝐒𝐤𝐢𝐧 𝐑𝐚𝐝𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞: The Kumkumadi Radiant Skin Face Oil effectively brightens the skin, giving it a natural and healthy radiance.
𝟐. 𝐑𝐞𝐝𝐮𝐜𝐞𝐬 𝐏𝐢𝐠𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: With regular use, this face oil helps in diminishing dark spots, blemishes, and pigmentation, resulting in a more even skin tone.
𝟑. 𝐌𝐨𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐳𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐇𝐲𝐝𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬: The nourishing properties of the oil deeply moisturize the skin, keeping it hydrated and supple throughout the day.
𝟒. 𝐅𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐬 𝐒𝐢𝐠𝐧𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐀𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐠: The potent blend of Ayurvedic ingredients in this oil helps to reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, and other signs of aging, promoting youthful-looking skin.
𝟓. 𝐈𝐦𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐒𝐤𝐢𝐧 𝐓𝐞𝐱𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞: The lightweight and non-greasy formula of the face oil absorbs quickly into the skin, improving its texture and leaving it smooth and soft.

Description
Tanend De-Tan Bleach Cream with Milk & Honey is a skin-brightening and whitening cream that helps remove tan and pigmentation, leaving the skin soft and glowing.
How to Use
• Wash your face and neck thoroughly with water and pat dry.
• Apply the Tanend Bleach cream on the face and neck and leave it on for 10-15 minutes.
• Rinse off with water and pat dry.
Key Features
• Helps remove tan and pigmentation
• Brightens and whitens the skin
• Softens and smooths the skin
• Contains natural ingredients like milk and honey that nourish the skin
• Suitable for all skin types.
Ingredients
Milk , Honey , Arbutin ,Saffron ,Turmeric
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
How long should I leave the bleach on?
Typically 10–15 minutes depending on your skin sensitivity — always follow the pack instructions.
What makes Tan End Bleach different from regular bleach?
It is specially formulated to target suntan, dullness, and uneven skin tone while being gentle on sensitive skin.
Can I use Tan End Bleach on sensitive skin?
Yes, it’s designed to be mild, but a patch test is always recommended for sensitive skin.
How long does the instant brightening effect last?
You will see results immediately, which can last 7–10 days depending on your skin type and exposure to sun.
How often should I use Tan End Bleach?
Use it once every 10-12 days for best results.

Description
Get instant glow with Aaryanveda’s
Haldi Chandan Herbal Bleach Cream
that gently brightens dull skin, fades tan, and gives a naturally lit-from-within radiance. With the purity of Haldi, the calmness of Chandan & herbal actives—it delivers a
safer, smoother, more luminous
glow in minutes!
How to Use
*Perform a patch test before use
*Cleanse the face/area and pat dry
*Mix bleach cream with activator (10:1 ratio)
*Apply evenly, avoiding eyes and lips
*Leave on for 10–15 minutes (8–10 minutes for sensitive skin)
*Remove with damp cotton and rinse with water
*Apply soothing gel or moisturizer after use
Key Features
𝟏 𝐇𝐚𝐥𝐝𝐢 𝐏𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫-Its antioxidant formula brightens skin tone and reduces dullness instantly.
𝟐.𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐧 𝐂𝐚𝐥𝐦-Soothes redness & irritation while giving a cooling, calming feel.
𝟑.𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐥𝐞 𝐓𝐨𝐮𝐜𝐡- Lightens facial hair & tan, giving a soft, smooth, even-toned glow.
𝟒.𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐆𝐥𝐨𝐰- Quick-action formula that works fast — ideal for last-minute events, functions, or daily glow-ups.
𝟓. 𝐅𝐚𝐬𝐭-𝐀𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐀𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐨𝐫- The advanced activator boosts the bleaching process, giving a brighter, cleaner glow in minutes — no long waiting!
Ingredients

FAQs
What are the benefits of Haldi Chandan Bleach?
It combines the goodness of Haldi and Chandan to reduce pigmentation, calm skin and give a natural glow.
Is this bleach suitable for acne-prone skin?
Yes, Haldi’s antibacterial and Chandan’s soothing properties help calm mild acne and redness.
Will this bleach make my skin dry?
No, the herbal blend ensures skin stays soft and balanced, but follow up with a moisturizer.
Can I use Haldi Chandan Bleach before a function?
Absolutely — it gives a fresh, bright look within minutes.
How frequently can I apply it?
Use once every 10-12 days to maintain an even tone.

Description
Experience a burst of natural nourishment with our Apricot Whip Moist Fruit Cream, crafted as an authentic Ayurvedic proprietary medicine. This luxurious cream blends the richness of apricot oil, sweet almond oil, olive oil, jojoba oil, and vitamin E to deliver deep hydration, visible softness, and a healthy, fruit-fresh glow.
How to Use
Take a small amount and massage gently onto clean skin using upward circular motions. Suitable for both day and night use.
Key Features
1.  𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐬𝐞 𝐌𝐨𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐳𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Apricot oil penetrates deeply to hydrate dry, dull, and tired-looking skin.
𝟐. 𝐒𝐨𝐟𝐭, 𝐒𝐮𝐩𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐓𝐞𝐱𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞: Sweet almond oil smoothens rough patches and enhances skin softness.
𝟑. 𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐥 𝐆𝐥𝐨𝐰: Olive oil, rich in antioxidants, supports overall skin vitality and improves luminosity.
𝟒.𝐁𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐢𝐧𝐠 & 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞:Jojoba oil balances sebum production while protecting the skin’s natural moisture barrier.
𝟓.𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐡𝐟𝐮𝐥 𝐑𝐚𝐝𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞: Vitamin E helps reduce oxidative stress, supporting firmer, healthier-looking skin.
Ingredients
Apricot,Almond,Jojoba Oil.
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.

What is this Fruit Cream for?
It hydrates and nourishes skin while enhancing natural glow for all seasons.

No — it’s lightweight and keeps skin soft without heaviness.

Use daily for best results.

Description
Tan-End Cream is a powerful anti-tan treatment enriched with lemon and tomato extract. It helps reduce melanin synthesis, remove sun tan, fight dullness, and support collagen and elastin regeneration for brighter, even-toned, and healthier-looking skin.
How to Use
𝟏.Cleanse your face thoroughly and pat dry.
𝟐.Apply a small amount of Tan-End Cream evenly over the affected tanned areas.
𝟑.Massage gently in upward circular motions until fully absorbed.
𝟒.Use twice daily—morning and night—for best results.
𝟓.Follow up with sunscreen during daytime exposure.
Key Features
•Removes sun tan and restores natural skin tone.
•Reduces melanin synthesis to prevent further tanning
•Fights dullness and brightens the complexion.
•Promotes regeneration of collagen & elastin.
•Enriched with lemon and tomato extract for deep skin repair.
•Lightweight, non-greasy daily-use formulation.
Ingredients
Tomato Extract, Lemon Extract.
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.

Lemon and tomato extracts help with brightness and tan removal.

Yes — apply daily for consistent results.
Will it feel greasy?
No — it absorbs into skin without heaviness.

With regular use it may help reduce appearance of spots.

Description
AaryanVeda Tanend De-Tan Facial Kit is a comprehensive solution designed to effectively remove tan and restore natural radiance to the skin. It combines powerful ingredients to deliver noticeable results and a rejuvenated complexion.
How to Use
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏: Cleanse your face with the provided face cleanser.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐: Exfoliate gently using the scrub in circular motions, focusing on areas with tan.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑: Use the massage gel to prep the skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒: Apply the massage cream and massage it gently on your skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟓: Apply the face pack evenly and leave it on for 15-20 minutes.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟔: Rinse off the pack and follow up with the tanend serum for enhanced results.
Key Features
• Removes tan and evens out skin tone
• Deeply nourishes and hydrates the skin
• Minimizes the appearance of dark spots and pigmentation
• Restores natural glow and radiance
• Provides a soothing and refreshing experience
Ingredients
GREEN TEA , BERGAMOT, PATCHOULI, LEMON OIL.
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What’s included in this facial kit?
Usually cleanser, scrub, massage gel, cream ,pack and face serum  for tanning care.
What does this kit help with?
It helps reduce sun tan, brighten skin & restore moisture balance.
Does it soothe inflamed skin?
Yes — the natural ingredients help soothe and refresh skin.
How long do I leave the pack on?
Typically 15–20 minutes as part of the regimen.
Can it improve skin elasticity?
The kit may help improve elasticity and brightening.

DELIVERY OF PRODUCTS
Purchases are shipped from our own or third party warehouses/ stores or offices from various points in India. Our endeavour is to make the products reach you within 5 to 8 business days for metro cities and 8 to 12 business days for non-metros from receipt of order and payment depending on the address for delivery.
Order deliveries will be made by our own staff or third party courier and logistics companies or Postal Services usually between 10.30 am - 7 pm Monday - Saturday.
Goods will need to be signed for upon delivery. We take no responsibility for goods signed by an alternative person other than the person ordering the product at the address indicated at the time of the order.
Since the transactions are authorized by the card holder, we do not take responsibility for incorrect addresses provided at the time of placing the order

Description
2% Retinol & Rosehip Face Serum is an advanced formula enriched with 2% retinol and rosehip oil extract that helps to reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, and dark spots while providing a plumping effect to the skin. This serum is perfect for men and women looking for a solution to combat ageing and achieve a more youthful and radiant complexion.
How to Use
• Apply 3-5 drops of 2% Retinol & Rosehip Face Serum on the entire face and neck (twice a day) in an upward circular motion.
• Massage using fingertips until the serum gets absorbed.
• During the day, follow it up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen moisturizer.
• Use continuously for 6 to 8 weeks for noticeable results.
Key Features
•Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
•Helps to even out skin tone and texture
•Provides a plumping effect to the skin
•Promotes healthy, youthful-looking skin
Ingredients
1% Manihot Esculenta Tuber Extract, 0.5% Hyaluronic Acid, 2% Retinol, Rosehip Oil

Description
Aaryanveda Aloe Vera & Cucumber Hydra Moisturizing Lotion deeply hydrates and nourishes dry skin, absorbing quickly without any oily feel. Enriched with natural aloe vera and cucumber extracts, it helps control dryness and roughness, heals dry pores, and restores your skin’s natural complexion. Leaves the skin soft, fresh, and naturally glowing.
How to Use
𝟏.Take a small amount of lotion in your palm.
𝟐. Apply evenly on cleansed skin.
𝟑. Massage gently in circular motions until fully absorbed.
𝟒.Use daily, especially after a bath or whenever your skin feels dry.
Key Features
𝟏. 𝐃𝐞𝐞𝐩 𝐇𝐲𝐝𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Moisturizes from within, keeping skin soft and supple all day.
𝟐. 𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐬 𝐃𝐫𝐲 𝐏𝐨𝐫𝐞𝐬: Aloe vera and cucumber nourish and repair dry, flaky skin.
𝟑. 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐥𝐬 𝐃𝐫𝐲𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬 & 𝐑𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬: Smoothens skin texture effectively.
𝟒. 𝐍𝐨𝐧-𝐎𝐢𝐥𝐲 𝐅𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐮𝐥𝐚: Lightweight and fast-absorbing lotion with no sticky residue.
𝟓. 𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐞𝐬 𝐍𝐚𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐱𝐢𝐨𝐧: Helps regain skin’s fresh, healthy, and glowing appearance.
𝟔. 𝐒𝐮𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐀𝐥𝐥 𝐒𝐤𝐢𝐧 𝐓𝐲𝐩𝐞𝐬: Gentle and effective for daily use.
Ingredients
Aloevera, Cucumber, ,Honey.
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What does this Hydra Moist Lotion do?
It deeply hydrates, cools, and nourishes the skin with Aloe Vera + Cucumber extracts.
Is it suitable for oily skin?
Yes — it’s lightweight, non-greasy, and absorbs quickly.
Can it be used as a daily moisturizer?
Absolutely — it’s perfect for regular day and night hydration.
Does it help soothe sun-exposed skin?
Yes! The Aloe + Cucumber blend gives an instant cooling and calming effect.
Can I use it under makeup?
Yes — it works as a smooth, hydrating base for makeup application.

FAQs
What makes Aaryanveda Sunscreen Cream SPF 50 PA+++ effective?
Aaryanveda Sunscreen Cream SPF 50 PA+++ provides broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection. Its SPF 50 and PA+++ rating help prevent sunburn, tanning, and premature skin ageing caused by UV exposure.
Is this sunscreen suitable for all skin types?
Yes.The formula is gentle and lightweight, making it suitable for all skin types.
Does it leave a white cast on the skin?
No. The sunscreen is designed to blend seamlessly with Indian skin tones, leaving no white residue or chalky finish.
Is the texture greasy or heavy?
Not at all. It has an ultra-lightweight, non-greasy texture that feels breathable and comfortable on the skin, making it ideal for daily use.
Can I use this sunscreen under makeup?
Yes. Its smooth, lightweight formula works well under makeup and does not cause pilling or heaviness.

Description
Experience powerful hair rejuvenation with our 2x more effective Onion Oil, formulated to combat premature graying, reduce dandruff, and control hair fall. Enriched with onion oil, olive oil, almond oil, and bhringraj, this nutrient-rich blend strengthens roots, promotes healthier growth, and restores natural shine.
How to Use
• Apply a few drops of the onion oil onto your scalp and gently massage it in circular motions.
• Leave it on for at least 2 hours or overnight for better results.
• Rinse thoroughly with a mild shampoo.
Key Features
• 2x more effective formula for visible results
• Helps reduce premature greying and maintains natural hair pigment.
• Controls dandruff and soothes scalp irritation
• Strengthens hair roots to reduce hair fall
• Deeply nourishes and revitalizes hair from root to tip
Ingredients
Onion Oil, Olive Oil, Almond Oil, Bhringraj
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What are the main benefits of using this Onion Oil?
This Onion Oil is designed to combat premature greying, reduce dandruff, and control hair fall. Its 2x more effective formulation strengthens hair roots, nourishes the scalp, and promotes healthier, shinier hair growth.
How long does it take to see visible results?
Most users begin to notice reduced hair fall and improved scalp health within 3–4 weeks of regular use. Results may vary based on individual hair conditions and consistency of application.
Can this Onion Oil be used on all hair types?
Yes, the oil is suitable for all hair types.
Is it safe to leave the oil on overnight?
Yes, leaving the oil overnight enhances absorption and nourishment. For best results, apply the oil, massage gently, leave overnight, and wash with a mild shampoo the next morning.
Can men and women both use this product?
Absolutely. The Onion Oil is formulated for both men and women and works effectively for all genders.

Description
Hydramoist Skin Moisturizer Sunscreen SPF 30 PA+++ is a 2-in-1 all-season formula designed to deliver deep hydration and broad-spectrum sun protection in one step. Dermatologically tested, this lightweight moisturizer offers 48+ hours of moisture retention with a smooth, easy-spreading texture. Ideal for daily use, it keeps skin soft, protected, and nourished for up to 12 months after opening. Perfect for all skin types seeking hydration and sun defense in a single product.
How to Use
• Apply evenly on cleansed face and neck.
• Use at least 15 minutes before sun exposure.
• Reapply every 3–4 hours for continuous protection.
• Use daily for best hydration and skin protection results.
Key Features
• 2-in-1 moisturiser + sunscreen with SPF 30 PA+++
• Provides 48+ hours of long-lasting hydration
• Lightweight, non-greasy, and easy-spreading formula
•Suitable for all seasons and all skin types
• Dermatologically tested for safety
Ingredients
Shea Butter , Sweet Almond oil , Aloe Vera.
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What is Hydramoist Skin Moisturiser Sunscreen 2-in-1?
Hydramoist is a dual-action moisturiser and sunscreen with SPF 30 PA+++, designed to deliver long-lasting hydration while providing broad-spectrum sun protection for daily use.
Can I use this moisturiser sunscreen in all seasons?
Yes, the formula is crafted for year-round use. It maintains skin hydration in winter and protects against UV rays in summer, making it suitable for all weather conditions.
How long does the hydration effect last?
The moisturiser offers 48+ hours of deep hydration, helping your skin stay soft, smooth, and nourished throughout the day.
Is it suitable for all skin types?
Yes. Its lightweight, non-greasy texture and dermatologically tested formula make it ideal for all skin types, including normal, dry, combination, and sensitive skin.
How often should I reapply it for sun protection?
For optimal UV protection, reapply every 3–4 hours, especially during prolonged sun exposure, sweating, or outdoor activities.

Description
The Diamond HydraFacial Kit delivers luxurious hydration and rejuvenation with diamond-infused skincare. This premium treatment reduces fine lines and wrinkles, unveiling a smoother, more radiant complexion. Achieve glowing, youthful skin effortlessly with our advanced DIY facial care solution.
How to Use
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏 - 𝐂𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐞𝐫 : Cleanser Apply it to your fingertips and gently massage your face and neck for two to three minutes in a circular motion. Rinse thoroughly with water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐 - 𝐒𝐜𝐫𝐮𝐛 : Apply sufficient scrub to the face and massage gently in upward circular motions for 2–3 minutes to remove dead cells. Rinse thoroughly with water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑 - 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐆𝐞𝐥 :Take a sufficient quantity of massage gel and massage the face for 10–15 minutes for the best results. Wash off with plenty of water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒 - 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦 :Take sufficient amount to cover the face and neck area completely.Gently massage using your fingertips for 3 to 5 minutes.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟓 - 𝐅𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐏𝐚𝐜𝐤 : Apply a thick layer of pack to the face and neck.Leave for 10–15 minutes for best results, then rinse with water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟔 - 𝐅𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐒𝐞𝐫𝐮𝐦 : Spread the serum all over your face and massage in a circular motion. The serum penetrates deep into the skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟕 - 𝐄𝐲𝐞 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐤 :Apply a layer around the eye area.Leave it on for 20 minutes, wipe with moist cotton, or rinse it.
Key Features
• Provides deep hydration for plump and moisturized skin.
• Cleanses deeply to give a smoother and softer skin texture
• Boosts skin collagen to improve skin elasticity and firmness
• Rejuvenates the skin by reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
• Enhances skin radiance and provides a more even complexion
Ingredients
Diamond dust, carrot seed oil extract, green tea leaf extract, and licorice extract.
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What is this kit best for?
For deep hydration, smooth texture, and a diamond-like glow.
Is it safe for sensitive skin?
Yes, the soothing hydra formulas are gentle on sensitive skin.
How often can I use it?
Once every 10–15 days.
Does it brighten the skin?
Yes, it improves clarity and revives dull skin.
Does it contain diamond dust?
Yes, it includes diamond ash known for natural exfoliation and glow.

Description
Say hello to smooth, bright, and tan-free skin! Aaryanveda’s Papaya Hair Removing Cream melts away unwanted hair in just 2 minutes while the natural power of papaya enzymes gently exfoliates, fades tan, and boosts glow. Enjoy soft, fresh, and visibly brighter skin—effortlessly.
How to Use
1. Squeeze out the product
2. Lather it on the desired area
3. Leave for 2-5 minutes
4. Scrape it off with the spatula
5. Rinse with clean water
6. Pat dry after rinse
Key Features
𝟏. 𝐏𝐚𝐩𝐚𝐲𝐚 𝐄𝐧𝐳𝐲𝐦𝐞 𝐆𝐥𝐨𝐰-𝐔𝐩: Rich in natural papain, it gently exfoliates dead skin cells for instant brightness.
𝟐. 𝟐-𝐌𝐢𝐧𝐮𝐭𝐞 𝐐𝐮𝐢𝐜𝐤 𝐀𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 : Fast-acting formula removes hair quickly, painlessly, and evenly.
𝟑. 𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐃𝐞-𝐓𝐚𝐧 𝐄𝐟𝐟𝐞𝐜𝐭 : Helps fade sun tan and dullness, revealing fresher, clearer-looking skin.
𝟒. 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐨𝐭𝐡 & 𝐍𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐡 𝐅𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐮𝐥𝐚 : Leaves skin soft, hydrated, and silky without dryness or irritation.
𝟓. 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐥𝐞 𝐨𝐧 𝐒𝐤𝐢𝐧, 𝐓𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐨𝐧 𝐇𝐚𝐢𝐫 : No cuts, razor bumps, or waxing pain — just clean, smooth results.

FAQs
Why choose the Papaya Hair Removal Cream?
It contains papaya enzymes that help lighten tan and reduce ingrown hair.
Is it suitable for dry skin?
Yes, its moisturizing herbal blend keeps skin nourished after hair removal.
Does it remove tanning along with hair?
Yes. The papaya actives help reduce surface tan and dullness while removing hair, giving an even-toned look.
Can I use it weekly?
Yes, safe for regular use depending on hair growth.
Will it remove very fine hair?
Yes, it gives clean removal even for small, fine hair.

It helps reduce hair fall, promotes thicker hair growth, slows premature greying, and repairs dull, damaged strands. With each use, your hair will look healthier, shine more, and be stronger.
How to Use
• Apply a few drops of the onion oil onto your scalp and gently massage it in circular motions.
• Leave it on for at least 2 hours or overnight for better results.
• Rinse thoroughly with a mild shampoo.
Key Features

Description
Give your skin the ultimate winter care with the Kesar Malai DIY Facial Kit! This luxurious kit is infused with the richness of kesar (saffron) and malai (cream) to provide deep hydration, intense nourishment, and long-lasting moisturisation. Perfect for the chilly season, it leaves your skin feeling soft, supple, and glowing. Pamper yourself with this hydrating facial experience, crafted to combat winter dryness and bring out your natural radiance.
How to Use
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏 - 𝐂𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐞𝐫 : Cleanser Apply it to your fingertips and gently massage your face and neck for two to three minutes in a circular motion. Rinse thoroughly with water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐 - 𝐒𝐜𝐫𝐮𝐛 : Apply sufficient scrub to the face and massage gently in upward circular motions for 2–3 minutes to remove dead cells. Rinse thoroughly with water.

Description
Aaryanveda Winter Care Nourishing Honey & Almond Cream delivers intense hydration to combat winter dryness while giving your skin a smooth, velvety feel. Enriched with honey, almond oil, turmeric extract, and rose water, it deeply nourishes, softens, and restores natural glow for healthy, moisturised, winter-ready skin.
How to Use
• Apply a small amount of cream on clean, dry skin.
• Gently massage in upward circular motions until fully absorbed.
• Use daily, especially during winter or whenever skin feels dry.
• For best results, apply after bathing or before bedtime.
Key Features
•𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐬𝐞 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐇𝐲𝐝𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Deeply moisturizes to relieve dry and flaky skin.
•𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐨𝐭𝐡, 𝐕𝐞𝐥𝐯𝐞𝐭𝐲 𝐓𝐨𝐮𝐜𝐡: Leaves skin soft, silky, and nourished.
•𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐭𝐡𝐲, 𝐆𝐥𝐨𝐰𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐒𝐤𝐢𝐧: Enhances natural radiance with honey and almond oil.
•𝐍𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐈𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: Turmeric extract and rose water soothe, brighten, and refresh the skin.
•𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐅𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐮𝐥𝐚: Helps lock in moisture and prevents dryness throughout the day.
Ingredients
Turmeric Extract, Rose water , Honey ,Almond oil.
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What does the Honey Almond Cream help with?
It deeply moisturizes dry skin and restores a soft, glowing texture.
Is it suitable for daily use?
Yes — it’s gentle enough to be used both in the morning and night for hydration.
Will it feel heavy on oily skin?
It’s enriched but keeps a balanced, non-greasy texture to avoid heaviness.
Does it have antibacterial benefits?
Yes — honey naturally helps with mild antibacterial action, calming minor inflammation.
Can it be used in winters?
Absolutely — its rich formula helps lock in moisture during cold, dry months.

Description
30% AHA + 2% BHA Face peeling is an advanced skincare product designed to improve the texture and appearance of your skin. This highly effective peeling solution contains a blend of 30% Alpha Hydroxy Acids (AHAs) and 2% Beta Hydroxy Acid (BHA) that work together to exfoliate dead skin cells and unclog pores, revealing smoother, brighter, and more radiant skin.
How to Use
• On a clean & dry face, apply the face peeling solution, not more than twice a week in the evening.
• Leave it on for no longer than 10 minutes.
• Use cleanser with lukewarm water to clean the peeling solution.
• Use a mild moisturizer afterwards, followed by a broad-spectrum sunscreen.
• Use continuously for 6 to 8 weeks for noticeable results.
Key Features
• Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
• Improves skin texture and tone
• Minimizes the appearance of pores
• Helps fade dark spots and hyperpigmentation
• Promotes collagen production
• Gives a healthy glow to the skin
Ingredients
2% Salicylic Acid, 10% Glycollic Acid, 10% Mandelic Acid, 10% Lactic Acid.

Enriched with honey, almond oil, turmeric extract, and rose water, it deeply nourishes, softens, and restores natural glow for healthy, moisturised, winter-ready skin.
How to Use
• Apply a small amount of cream on clean, dry skin.
• Gently massage in upward circular motions until fully absorbed.
• Use daily, especially during winter or whenever skin feels dry.
• For best results, apply after bathing or before bedtime.

•𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐬𝐞 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐇𝐲𝐝𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Deeply moisturizes to relieve dry and flaky skin.

FAQs
What does the Honey Almond Cream help with?
It deeply moisturizes dry skin and restores a soft, glowing texture.
Is it suitable for daily use?
Yes — it’s gentle enough to be used both in the morning and night for hydration.
Will it feel heavy on oily skin?
It’s enriched but keeps a balanced, non-greasy texture to avoid heaviness.

Yes — honey naturally helps with mild antibacterial action, calming minor inflammation.

Description
Get brighter and illuminated skin with Glowelle Vitamin C 20% Face Serum. Infused with orange, lemon, and witch hazel, this lightweight formula absorbs quickly to provide a natural glow, even out skin tone and texture, and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Suitable for both men and women, this 30 ML bottle provides antioxidant protection against environmental stressors while leaving your skin feeling soft and hydrated.
How to Use
•  Apply 3-5 drops of Glowelle Vitamin C 20% Face Serum on the entire face and neck
(twice a day) in an upward circular motion.
• Massage using fingertips until the serum gets absorbed.
•  During the day, follow it up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen moisturizer.
•  Use continuously for 6 to 8 weeks for noticeable results.

Description
2% Retinol & Rosehip Face Serum is an advanced formula enriched with 2% retinol and rosehip oil extract that helps to reduce the appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, and dark spots while providing a plumping effect to the skin. This serum is perfect for men and women looking for a solution to combat ageing and achieve a more youthful and radiant complexion.
How to Use
• Apply 3-5 drops of 2% Retinol & Rosehip Face Serum on the entire face and neck (twice a day) in an upward circular motion.

• Use continuously for 6 to 8 weeks for noticeable results.

•Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles

•Promotes healthy, youthful-looking skin

Description
Aaryanveda 24 Carat Gold Bleach Cream is a premium-quality product designed to lighten facial hair while nourishing and rejuvenating the skin.
How to Use
•Cleanse your face with face wash and pat dry.
•Mix the Gold bleach cream and powder activator.
•Apply the mixture evenly on the face and Neck .
•Leave it for 15 minutes and then rinse it off with cold water.
Key Features
•Lightens facial hair and reduces pigmentation.
•Gives the skin a brighter and more radiant look.
•Nourishes and hydrates the skin.
•Helps in improving skin texture and tone.
•Provides a spa-like experience at home.
Ingredients
Gold Particles, Aloevera Extract
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What does 24K Gold Bleach do for the skin?
It gives an instant golden glow, boosts radiance and helps skin look youthful and refreshed.
Is it safe for bridal or party-ready skin?
Yes! It’s ideal before weddings, festivals, or any special event for a premium facial glow.
Will 24K Gold Bleach irritate my skin?
It’s gentle, but patch testing is recommended if you have super-sensitive skin.
How long do the results last?
The glow can last 7–10 days with proper skincare.
Can I use it with other skincare products?
Yes, you can follow it up with toner and moisturizer — avoid exfoliation for 24 hours.

Description
Give your skin the ultimate winter care with the Kesar Malai DIY Facial Kit! This luxurious kit is infused with the richness of kesar (saffron) and malai (cream) to provide deep hydration, intense nourishment, and long-lasting moisturisation. Perfect for the chilly season, it leaves your skin feeling soft, supple, and glowing. Pamper yourself with this hydrating facial experience, crafted to combat winter dryness and bring out your natural radiance.
How to Use
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏 - 𝐂𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐞𝐫 : Cleanser Apply it to your fingertips and gently massage your face and neck for two to three minutes in a circular motion. Rinse thoroughly with water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐 - 𝐒𝐜𝐫𝐮𝐛 : Apply sufficient scrub to the face and massage gently in upward circular motions for 2–3 minutes to remove dead cells. Rinse thoroughly with water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑 - 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐆𝐞𝐥 :Take a sufficient quantity of massage gel and massage the face for 10–15 minutes for the best results. Wash off with plenty of water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒 - 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦 :Take sufficient amount to cover the face and neck area completely.Gently massage using your fingertips for 3 to 5 minutes.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟓 - 𝐅𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐏𝐚𝐜𝐤 : Apply a thick layer of pack to the face and neck.Leave for 10–15 minutes for best results, then rinse with water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟔 - 𝐅𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐒𝐞𝐫𝐮𝐦 : Spread the serum all over your face and massage in a circular motion. The serum penetrates deep into the skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟕 - 𝐄𝐲𝐞 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐤 :Apply a layer around the eye area.Leave it on for 20 minutes, wipe with moist cotton, or rinse it.
Key Features
•Nourishing formula ideal for sensitive, dry, or combination skin.
•Enriched with kesar and malai for a natural, radiant glow.
•Easy DIY kit for spa-like pampering anytime.
•Specially formulated for deep hydration during colder months.

Description
Tea Tree with Neem and Aloe Vera. Facewash contains Milli Capsules and Tulsi to help control pimples and acne while deeply cleansing the skin. This ayurvedic facewash cleans pores, removes excess oil, and promotes clear, healthy-looking skin. Suitable for any skin type.
How to Use
•Apply a small amount of Tea Tree with Neem & Aloe Vera Facewash to wet skin.
•Massage gently in circular motions to cleanse deeply
•Rinse thoroughly with water and pat dry
•Use twice daily for best anti-acne results.
Key Features
•Anti-pimple and anti-acne ayurvedic facewash
•Deeply purifies skin and unclogs pores
•Helps control excess oil and breakouts
•Enriched with Tea Tree, Neem, Aloe Vera, and Tulsi
•Gentle daily cleanser for clear and fresh skin
•Suitable for all skin types
Ingredients

Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
Q. Who is this face wash suitable for?
A. It’s ideal for oily, combination and acne-prone skin — especially if you struggle with blemishes, excess oil or clogged pores.
Q.  How often should I use it and how?
A. Use it twice daily (morning & night) with pea-sized amounts.
Q. What are the key ingredients and their benefits?
A. Key ingredients include Tea Tree (antibacterial/antifungal), Neem, Aloe Vera, Tulsi (holy basil). The combination is meant to cleanse, nourish and protect the skin.
Q. Can sensitive skin use it? Any precautions?
A. While the formula uses herbal actives, if you have very sensitive or extremely dry skin, patch test first (especially on jawline/neck). Also avoid contact with eyes; if contact occurs rinse thoroughly.
Q. Will it dry out my skin or strip my skin barrier?
A. It “nourishes and moisturises the skin” even as it combats oil and bacteria.

Description
Get brighter and illuminated skin with Glowelle Vitamin C 20% Face Serum. Infused with orange, lemon, and witch hazel, this lightweight formula absorbs quickly to provide a natural glow, even out skin tone and texture, and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Suitable for both men and women, this 30 ML bottle provides antioxidant protection against environmental stressors while leaving your skin feeling soft and hydrated.
How to Use
•  Apply 3-5 drops of Glowelle Vitamin C 20% Face Serum on the entire face and neck
(twice a day) in an upward circular motion.
• Massage using fingertips until the serum gets absorbed.
•  During the day, follow it up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen moisturizer.
•  Use continuously for 6 to 8 weeks for noticeable results.
Key Features
• Provides a natural glow to the skin
•Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
•Evens out skin tone and texture
•Helps reduce hyperpigmentation and dark spots

Description
Our Cleansing Milk gently removes dirt, oil, and dead skin cells while soothing irritation and dryness. Enriched with cucumber, aloe vera, milk, and Lal Punarnava, it hydrates deeply, brightens skin tone, and leaves your complexion soft, calm, and naturally glowing. Perfect for daily cleansing and suitable for all skin types.
How to Use
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏: Take sufficient cleansing milk.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐: Spread thoroughly on face & neck.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑: Massage gently for 5 minutes.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒: Remove dirt and grime.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟓: Rinse with fresh water.
Key Features
1.Effectively cleanses away grime, dirt, and dead skin cells.
2.Helps to reduce itchiness, irritation, and swelling.

4.Provides deep hydration for moisturized skin.

FAQs
What does Aaryanveda Cleansing Milk do?
It gently removes dirt, makeup, and impurities without stripping your skin’s natural moisture.
Is it suitable for dry or sensitive skin?
Yes! Its creamy, soothing formula keeps skin soft and hydrated, making it ideal for dry & sensitive skin types.
Can I use it every day?
Absolutely — it’s mild enough for daily morning and night use.
How do I use it for best results?
Apply on face, massage in circular motions, and wipe off with cotton or rinse.
Does it leave the skin oily?
No — it leaves skin clean, nourished, and balanced without greasiness.

Description
Tea Tree with Neem and Aloe Vera. Facewash contains Milli Capsules and Tulsi to help control pimples and acne while deeply cleansing the skin. This ayurvedic facewash cleans pores, removes excess oil, and promotes clear, healthy-looking skin. Suitable for any skin type.
How to Use
•Apply a small amount of Tea Tree with Neem & Aloe Vera Facewash to wet skin.
•Massage gently in circular motions to cleanse deeply
•Rinse thoroughly with water and pat dry
•Use twice daily for best anti-acne results.
Key Features
•Anti-pimple and anti-acne ayurvedic facewash
•Deeply purifies skin and unclogs pores
•Helps control excess oil and breakouts
•Enriched with Tea Tree, Neem, Aloe Vera, and Tulsi
•Gentle daily cleanser for clear and fresh skin
•Suitable for all skin types
Ingredients
Aloe Vera Extract, Tea Tree Oil ,Neem ,Tulsi
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
Q. Who is this face wash suitable for?
A. It’s ideal for oily, combination and acne-prone skin — especially if you struggle with blemishes, excess oil or clogged pores.
Q.  How often should I use it and how?
A. Use it twice daily (morning & night) with pea-sized amounts.
Q. What are the key ingredients and their benefits?
A. Key ingredients include Tea Tree (antibacterial/antifungal), Neem, Aloe Vera, Tulsi (holy basil). The combination is meant to cleanse, nourish and protect the skin.
Q. Can sensitive skin use it? Any precautions?
A. While the formula uses herbal actives, if you have very sensitive or extremely dry skin, patch test first (especially on jawline/neck). Also avoid contact with eyes; if contact occurs rinse thoroughly.
Q. Will it dry out my skin or strip my skin barrier?
A. It “nourishes and moisturises the skin” even as it combats oil and bacteria.

Description
Hydramoist Skin Moisturizer Sunscreen SPF 30 PA+++ is a 2-in-1 all-season formula designed to deliver deep hydration and broad-spectrum sun protection in one step. Dermatologically tested, this lightweight moisturizer offers 48+ hours of moisture retention with a smooth, easy-spreading texture. Ideal for daily use, it keeps skin soft, protected, and nourished for up to 12 months after opening. Perfect for all skin types seeking hydration and sun defense in a single product.
How to Use
• Apply evenly on cleansed face and neck.
• Use at least 15 minutes before sun exposure.
• Reapply every 3–4 hours for continuous protection.
• Use daily for best hydration and skin protection results.
Key Features
• 2-in-1 moisturiser + sunscreen with SPF 30 PA+++
• Provides 48+ hours of long-lasting hydration
• Lightweight, non-greasy, and easy-spreading formula
•Suitable for all seasons and all skin types
• Dermatologically tested for safety
Ingredients
Shea Butter , Sweet Almond oil , Aloe Vera.
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What is Hydramoist Skin Moisturiser Sunscreen 2-in-1?
Hydramoist is a dual-action moisturiser and sunscreen with SPF 30 PA+++, designed to deliver long-lasting hydration while providing broad-spectrum sun protection for daily use.
Can I use this moisturiser sunscreen in all seasons?
Yes, the formula is crafted for year-round use. It maintains skin hydration in winter and protects against UV rays in summer, making it suitable for all weather conditions.
How long does the hydration effect last?
The moisturiser offers 48+ hours of deep hydration, helping your skin stay soft, smooth, and nourished throughout the day.
Is it suitable for all skin types?
Yes. Its lightweight, non-greasy texture and dermatologically tested formula make it ideal for all skin types, including normal, dry, combination, and sensitive skin.
How often should I reapply it for sun protection?
For optimal UV protection, reapply every 3–4 hours, especially during prolonged sun exposure, sweating, or outdoor activities.

Description
Get brighter and illuminated skin with Glowelle Vitamin C 20% Face Serum. Infused with orange, lemon, and witch hazel, this lightweight formula absorbs quickly to provide a natural glow, even out skin tone and texture, and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Suitable for both men and women, this 30 ML bottle provides antioxidant protection against environmental stressors while leaving your skin feeling soft and hydrated.
How to Use
•  Apply 3-5 drops of Glowelle Vitamin C 20% Face Serum on the entire face and neck
(twice a day) in an upward circular motion.
• Massage using fingertips until the serum gets absorbed.
•  During the day, follow it up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen moisturizer.
•  Use continuously for 6 to 8 weeks for noticeable results.
Key Features
• Provides a natural glow to the skin
•Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
•Evens out skin tone and texture
•Helps reduce hyperpigmentation and dark spots
Ingredients
Orange Extract, Lemon Extract, 20% Vitamin C, Witch Hazel Extract

FAQs
What makes Aaryanveda Sunscreen Cream SPF 50 PA+++ effective?
Aaryanveda Sunscreen Cream SPF 50 PA+++ provides broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection. Its SPF 50 and PA+++ rating help prevent sunburn, tanning, and premature skin ageing caused by UV exposure.
Is this sunscreen suitable for all skin types?
Yes.The formula is gentle and lightweight, making it suitable for all skin types.
Does it leave a white cast on the skin?
No. The sunscreen is designed to blend seamlessly with Indian skin tones, leaving no white residue or chalky finish.
Is the texture greasy or heavy?
Not at all. It has an ultra-lightweight, non-greasy texture that feels breathable and comfortable on the skin, making it ideal for daily use.
Can I use this sunscreen under makeup?
Yes. Its smooth, lightweight formula works well under makeup and does not cause pilling or heaviness.

Description

How to Use
𝟏.Cleanse your face thoroughly and pat dry.
𝟐.Apply a small amount of Tan-End Cream evenly over the affected tanned areas.
𝟑.Massage gently in upward circular motions until fully absorbed.
𝟒.Use twice daily—morning and night—for best results.
𝟓.Follow up with sunscreen during daytime exposure.
Key Features
•Removes sun tan and restores natural skin tone.
•Reduces melanin synthesis to prevent further tanning
•Fights dullness and brightens the complexion.
•Promotes regeneration of collagen & elastin.
•Enriched with lemon and tomato extract for deep skin repair.
•Lightweight, non-greasy daily-use formulation.

Description
Whitofair Skin Whitening Cream with SPF 50 is enriched with 2% Glucan, Palmaria Palmata Red Algae, and Vitamin B3. It helps improve skin complexion, lighten dark spots, brighten dull skin, and protect from sun damage for a visibly fairer, radiant look.
How to Use
• Cleanse your face and gently pat dry.
• Apply a small amount of Whitofair Cream evenly on the face and neck.
• Massage in upward circular motions until absorbed.
• Use daily in the morning for sun protection and skin brightening.
• Reapply SPF during long sun exposure for best results..
Key Features
• Brightens skin and enhances natural complexion.
• Lightens pigmentation and dark spots.
• Provides SPF 50 protection from UV damage.
• Enriched with 2% Glucan for skin repair & hydration.
• Contains Palmaria Palmata Red Algae for radiance.
• Vitamin B3 improves clarity and smoothness.

Description
Neem & 2% BHA Acne Busting Face Serum is a powerful solution for acne-prone skin. With neem extract and 2% BHA, it unclogs pores, removes dead skin cells, and reduces inflammation.
How to Use
• Apply 3-5 drops of serum on the entire face and neck (twice a day) in an upward circular motion.
• Massage using fingertips until the serum gets absorbed.
• During the day, follow it up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen moisturizer .
• Use continuously for 6 to 8 weeks for noticeable results.
Key Features
•Helps clear up acne
•Unclogs pores and removes dead skin cells
•Reduces inflammation and redness
•Improves overall texture and appearance of skin
•Lightweight formula absorbs quickly
•Can reduce frequency and severity of breakouts
Ingredients
Cinnamon Extract, Tea Tree Oil , Neem Extract, 2% Salicylic Acid, 1% Niacinamide.

Description
Aaryanveda 24 Carat Gold Bleach Cream is a premium-quality product designed to lighten facial hair while nourishing and rejuvenating the skin.
How to Use
•Cleanse your face with face wash and pat dry.
•Mix the Gold bleach cream and powder activator.
•Apply the mixture evenly on the face and Neck .
•Leave it for 15 minutes and then rinse it off with cold water.
Key Features
•Lightens facial hair and reduces pigmentation.
•Gives the skin a brighter and more radiant look.
•Nourishes and hydrates the skin.
•Helps in improving skin texture and tone.
•Provides a spa-like experience at home.
Ingredients
Gold Particles , Aloevera Extract

Description
Hyaluronic Acid + Red Algae Extract Face Serum combines the power of hyaluronic acid and red algae extract to provide you with a brighter and healthier-looking complexion. This lightweight and fast-absorbing formula is designed to deeply hydrate your skin and protect it from environmental stressors. The hyaluronic acid in this serum works to attract and retain moisture, leaving your skin plump and hydrated. Meanwhile, the red algae extract helps to reduce inflammation and soothe your skin, giving you a more even and radiant complexion.
How to Use
• Apply 3-5 drops of serum on the entire face and neck (twice a day) in an upward circular motion.
• Massage using fingertips until the serum gets absorbed.
• During the day, follow it up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen moisturizer.
• Use continuously for 6 to 8 weeks for noticeable results.
Key Features
•Provides deep hydration to the skin
•Reduces inflammation and soothes the skin
•Protects the skin from environmental stressors
•Lightweight and fast-absorbing formula
•Suitable for all skin types
Ingredients
2% Red Algae Extract, 2% Hyaluronic Acid, 1% Sodium PCA, Aloe Vera Extract.

Description
30% AHA + 2% BHA Face peeling is an advanced skincare product designed to improve the texture and appearance of your skin. This highly effective peeling solution contains a blend of 30% Alpha Hydroxy Acids (AHAs) and 2% Beta Hydroxy Acid (BHA) that work together to exfoliate dead skin cells and unclog pores, revealing smoother, brighter, and more radiant skin.
How to Use
• On a clean & dry face, apply the face peeling solution, not more than twice a week in the evening.
• Leave it on for no longer than 10 minutes.
• Use cleanser with lukewarm water to clean the peeling solution.
• Use a mild moisturizer afterwards, followed by a broad-spectrum sunscreen.
• Use continuously for 6 to 8 weeks for noticeable results.
Key Features
• Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
• Improves skin texture and tone

• Helps fade dark spots and hyperpigmentation
• Promotes collagen production
• Gives a healthy glow to the skin

Description
Elevate your skincare routine with the Aaryanveda Body Polishing Kit, a holistic solution that nourishes your skin from within and enhances deep-layer texture. Enriched with natural oils and herbal elements, this kit helps combat wrinkles, fine lines, saggy skin, and tanning. Gently exfoliating, it unveils a younger, more attractive appearance by removing dead cells. Promoting healthy cell growth and deep hydration, it cleanses by unclogging pores. The natural de-tanning process rejuvenates your skin, combating dark spots and blemishes caused by pollution and environmental factors. Each component plays a role in transforming your skin. The scrub delicately exfoliates, revealing fresher, toned skin, while the pack revitalizes, promoting a healthier, radiant complexion.
How to Use
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏: Gently massage a sufficient amount of cleanser in a circular motion for 2-3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with fresh water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩𝟐: Massage an adequate amount of scrub in a circular motion for 15 minutes.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩𝟑: Apply a generous layer of the pack and let it sit for 15-20 minutes then rinse off with fresh water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒: Finish by massaging the nourishing oil in a circular motion.
Key Features
1.Achieve effective de-tanning, revealing a refreshed look.

Description
Restore clarity and balance to your complexion with our Pigmented De-pigmentation Facial Kit, designed to control pigmentation and promote even skin tone. This complete 6-step professional facial is formulated by experts, combining Ayurvedic wisdom with dermatological science. Enriched with almond oil, olive oil, and cucumber extracts, it deeply nourishes, cools, and renews tired, pigmented skin. Ideal for all skin types seeking a brighter and more luminous finish.
How to Use
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏: Cleanse your face with the provided face cleanser.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐: Exfoliate gently using the scrub in circular motions, focusing on areas with tan.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑: Use the massage gel to prep the skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒: Apply the massage cream and massage it gently on your skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟓: Apply the face pack evenly and leave it on for 15-20 minutes.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟔: Rinse off the pack and follow up with the serum for enhanced results.
Key Features
• Effectively reduces pigmentation and dark spots.
• Promotes an even skin tone for a radiant complexion.
• Minimizes the appearance of blemishes and discoloration.
• Nourishes and hydrates the skin, improving its texture and suppleness.
• Provides a rejuvenating experience, leaving you with refreshed and glowing skin.
Ingredients
Almond Oil, Olive Oil, Cucumber.
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What’s the purpose of this kit?
It helps reduce pigmentation & dark spots for even skin tone.
What key ingredients are used?
Enriched with almond oil, olive oil, cucumber extract for soothing & nourishment.
How many steps are there?
It’s a complete regimen with cleanser, scrub, massage gel, cream, pack & serum.
How often should I use it?
Follow the kit instructions; typically once per week for best results.

Yes — formulated for general use but patch testing is suggested.

How to Use
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏: Cleanse your face with the provided face cleanser.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐: Exfoliate gently using the scrub in circular motions, focusing on areas with Acne.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑: Use the massage gel to prep the skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒: Apply the massage cream and massage it gently on your skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟓: Apply the face pack evenly and leave it on for 15-20 minutes.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟔: Rinse off the pack and follow up with the serum for enhanced results.

𝟏.𝐅𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐬 𝐀𝐜𝐧𝐞-causing bacteria & helps prevent new pimples from forming.

𝟒.𝐍𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐡 𝐖𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐆𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞- Lightweight hydration keeps skin soft without making it oily.

It helps prevent new breakouts, control oil & purify pores.

Diamond Spa Facial is designed for instant skin lightening, tightening, and firming.  Infused with diamond-inspired actives to revive dull skin, improve elasticity, and deliver a radiant, spa-like glow.  Ideal for achieving smoother, brighter, and youthful-looking skin in minutes.
How to Use
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏: Cleanse your face with the provided face cleanser.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐: Exfoliate gently using the scrub in circular motions, focusing on areas with tan.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑: Use the massage gel to prep the skin.

FAQs
What is the Diamond Facial Kit for?
It helps purify congested pores, reduce blemishes, and offer a radiant, polished glow.
Does it contain real diamond dust?
Yes — it includes diamond ash + botanical extracts for a deep-clean feel.
Does it help with pigmentation?
Yes, the scrub gently exfoliates and targets dark spots.
Is it suitable for regular use?
It’s best used 1–2 times a month (depending on your skin) to maintain glow without over-exfoliating.
Will it dry out my skin?
No, it also helps hydrate while cleansing and exfoliating, leaving skin smooth and radiant.

The scrub delicately exfoliates, revealing fresher, toned skin, while the pack revitalizes, promoting a healthier, radiant complexion.

Description
Diamond Spa Facial is designed for instant skin lightening, tightening, and firming.  Infused with diamond-inspired actives to revive dull skin, improve elasticity, and deliver a radiant, spa-like glow.  Ideal for achieving smoother, brighter, and youthful-looking skin in minutes.
How to Use
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏: Cleanse your face with the provided face cleanser.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐: Exfoliate gently using the scrub in circular motions, focusing on areas with tan.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑: Use the massage gel to prep the skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒: Apply the massage cream and massage it gently on your skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟓: Apply the face pack evenly and leave it on for 15-20 minutes and then rinse it off.
Key Features
• Deeply nourishes and hydrates the skin, leaving it soft and supple.
• Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, promoting a youthful complexion.
• Brightens the skin tone, giving it a healthy and radiant glow.
• Helps in the removal of dead skin cells, revealing smoother and fresher-looking skin.
• Provides a relaxing and rejuvenating experience, promoting overall well-being.
Ingredients
Diamond Bhasm, Tulsi Extract,Almond Oil ,Aloevera
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What is the Diamond Facial Kit for?
It helps purify congested pores, reduce blemishes, and offer a radiant, polished glow.
Does it contain real diamond dust?
Yes — it includes diamond ash + botanical extracts for a deep-clean feel.
Does it help with pigmentation?
Yes, the scrub gently exfoliates and targets dark spots.
Is it suitable for regular use?
It’s best used 1–2 times a month (depending on your skin) to maintain glow without over-exfoliating.
Will it dry out my skin?
No, it also helps hydrate while cleansing and exfoliating, leaving skin smooth and radiant.

Description
Get brighter and illuminated skin with Glowelle Vitamin C 20% Face Serum. Infused with orange, lemon, and witch hazel, this lightweight formula absorbs quickly to provide a natural glow, even out skin tone and texture, and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Suitable for both men and women, this 30 ML bottle provides antioxidant protection against environmental stressors while leaving your skin feeling soft and hydrated.
How to Use
•  Apply 3-5 drops of Glowelle Vitamin C 20% Face Serum on the entire face and neck
(twice a day) in an upward circular motion.
• Massage using fingertips until the serum gets absorbed.
•  During the day, follow it up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen moisturizer.
•  Use continuously for 6 to 8 weeks for noticeable results.
Key Features
• Provides a natural glow to the skin
•Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles

•Helps reduce hyperpigmentation and dark spots

Description

promotes an even, youthful complexion while reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Infused with skin-loving ingredients, this cream leaves skin feeling supple and refreshed. This premium skincare cream is specifically formulated to provide you with fair and radiant skin while reducing the appearance of wrinkles and fine lines. Infused with natural ingredients, it deeply nourishes and moisturises the skin, leaving it looking healthier and younger
How to Use
𝟏.Cleanse your face with lukewarm water and pat dry.
𝟐.Apply the cream on your face and neck.
𝟑.Massage gently in circular motions until fully absorbed.
𝟒.Use twice daily for 6–8 weeks for best results.
Key Features
• Diminishes fine lines and wrinkles
• Reduces the appearance of age spots

Description
Experience the ultimate indulgence with our Wine Spa Facial, a luxurious treatment infused with the essence of grapes and wine. Rejuvenate your skin while enjoying the antioxidant-rich benefits of this unique experience.
How to Use
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏:Cleanse your face with the provided face cleanser.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐:Exfoliate gently using the scrub in circular motions, focusing on areas with tan.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑:Use the massage gel to prep the skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒:Apply the massage cream and massage it gently on your skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟓: Apply the face pack evenly and leave it on for 15-20 minutes and then rinse it off.
Key Features
• Nourishes and hydrates the skin, promoting a healthy glow.
• Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, giving a more youthful appearance.
• Improves skin elasticity and firmness, resulting in a smoother texture.
• Helps to even out skin tone and diminishes the visibility of dark spots.
• Provides antioxidants that protect the skin from environmental damage and premature aging.
Ingredients
GrapeSeed Oil ,Raspberry, Chamomile.
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What’s the main benefit of the Wine Kit?
It’s anti-ageing — enriched with antioxidant-rich wine extract to boost skin firmness and glow.
Does it reduce dullness?
Yes, the natural AHAs and antioxidants in wine work to revitalize and brighten tired skin.
Can it help with early wrinkles?
Absolutely — regular use supports skin elasticity and reduces fine lines.
How often should I use the Wine Facial Kit?
Use it every 12–15 days for anti-ageing and skin renewal benefits.
Is it harsh or chemical-based?
No — the formula is botanical and gentle, combining natural wine actives with skin-loving herbs.

Description
Experience the rejuvenating power of nature with our Papaya Spa Facial Kit. Indulge in a luxurious spa-like experience at home and unveil a radiant and glowing complexion.
How to Use
𝗦𝘁𝗲𝗽 𝟭: Cleanse your face with the provided face cleanser.
𝗦𝘁𝗲𝗽 𝟮: Exfoliate gently using the scrub in circular motions, focusing on areas with tan.
𝗦𝘁𝗲𝗽 𝟯: Use the massage gel to prep the skin.
𝗦𝘁𝗲𝗽 𝟰: Apply the massage cream and massage it gently on your skin.
𝗦𝘁𝗲𝗽 𝟱: Apply the face pack evenly and leave it on for 15-20 minutes and then rinse it off.
Key Features
•Brightens and lightens the skin tone.
•Removes dead skin cells and unclogs pores.
•Reduces the appearance of blemishes and dark spots.
•Hydrates and moisturizes the skin, leaving it soft and supple.
•Improves skin elasticity and promotes a youthful appearance.
Ingredients
Carrot Seed Oil,Papaya ,Rose ,Olive Oil,Cucumber ,Orange.
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What does the Papaya Kit help with?
It targets blemishes, pigmentation, and dull skin using papaya’s natural enzymes.
Is it good for acne marks?
Yes — the exfoliating power of papaya helps fade acne scars over regular use.
Will it be too harsh on sensitive skin?
No, it’s gentle but effective; do a patch test if your skin is very sensitive.
How often should I use the Papaya Kit?
Use once in 10–15 days for a gentle enzyme facial.
What results can I expect?
Smoother skin, fewer blemishes, and a more even, brighter complexion.

Description
How to Use
𝐇𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐨 𝐔𝐬𝐞:
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏: Cleanse your face with the provided face cleanser.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐: Exfoliate gently using the scrub in circular motions, focusing on areas with tan.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑: Use the massage gel to prep the skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒: Apply the massage cream and massage it gently on your skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟓: Apply the face pack evenly and leave it on for 15-20 minutes and then rinse it off.
Key Features
•Restores radiance and luminosity to the skin
•Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
•Provides intense hydration and moisturization
•Evens out skin tone and improves texture
•Enhances the skin's natural elasticity
Ingredients
Gold Particles, Olive,Rose Extract.
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What skin benefit does the Gold Kit offer?
It deeply revitalizes skin, leaving it with a radiant, youthful glow.
Does the kit help with aging signs?
Yes — the gold particles and botanical actives help reduce fine lines and wrinkles.
Is the Gold Kit gentle or harsh?
It’s formulated with mild botanical ingredients for a spa-like but safe effect.
How often should I use the Gold Kit?
Use it once or twice a month for a glowing boost (or as your facial routine allows).
Is this a chemical facial kit?
No — it focuses on gold + natural botanicals without harsh chemical peels.

Description
Fruit Spa Facial Kit designed to leave your skin looking young and radiant. Enriched with the benefits of papaya, orange, watermelon, and cucumber, it improves overall skin texture, gets rid of dark circles, and minimises fine lines. This revitalising facial restores the skin's natural brightness, smoothness, and youthful, healthy glow by deeply nourishing and revitalising the skin. All skin types can benefit from a full spa-like facial experience.
How to Use
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏: Cleanse your face with the provided face cleanser.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐: Exfoliate gently using the scrub in circular motions, focusing on areas with tan.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑: Use the massage gel to prep the skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒: Apply the massage cream and massage it gently on your skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟓: Apply the face pack evenly and leave it on for 15-20 minutes and then rinse it off.
Key Features
• Deeply nourishes and moisturizes the skin.
• Restores natural radiance and brightness.
• Minimizes the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.
• Improves skin elasticity and firmness.
• Provides a soothing and refreshing experience.
Ingredients
Cucumber ,Watermelon ,Orange,Papaya.
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What makes the Fruit Kit special?
It’s enriched with papaya, orange, cucumber, and watermelon to nourish, brighten & rejuvenate.
Can it reduce fine lines?
Yes — the natural fruit actives help minimize the appearance of fine lines.
Is it suitable for all skin types?
Yes, especially great for dull, dry, or uneven skin since it’s very hydrating.
What’s inside the kit?
It includes 5 products, a cleanser, scrub, massage gel, massage cream and face pack.
How long to leave the face pack on?
Leave the pack on for around 15–20 minutes before rinsing off to let fruit actives work.

Description
Aaryanveda De-Tan Facial DIY Kit is your at-home solution for a radiant complexion. Enriched with the goodness of natural ingredients, it effectively removes tan, brightens skin, and provides deep hydration. This kit revitalises your skin, leaving it smooth, supple, and protected from sun damage.
How to Use
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏 - 𝐂𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐞𝐫 : Cleanser Apply it to your fingertips and gently massage your face and neck for two to three minutes in a circular motion. Rinse thoroughly with water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐 - 𝐒𝐜𝐫𝐮𝐛 : Apply sufficient scrub to the face and massage gently in upward circular motions for 2–3 minutes to remove dead cells. Rinse thoroughly with water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑 - 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐆𝐞𝐥 :Take a sufficient quantity of massage gel and massage the face for 10–15 minutes for the best results. Wash off with plenty of water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒 - 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦 :Take sufficient amount to cover the face and neck area completely.Gently massage using your fingertips for 3 to 5 minutes.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟓 - 𝐅𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐏𝐚𝐜𝐤 : Apply a thick layer of pack to the face and neck.Leave for 10–15 minutes for best results, then rinse with water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟔 - 𝐅𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐒𝐞𝐫𝐮𝐦 : Spread the serum all over your face and massage in a circular motion. The serum penetrates deep into the skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟕 - 𝐄𝐲𝐞 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐤 :Apply a layer around the eye area.Leave it on for 20 minutes, wipe with moist cotton or rinse it.
Key Features
• Removes tanning and effectively brightens the dull skin complexion.
• Protects the skin from UV damage and radical factors.
• Provides deep nourishment and hydration to the skin.
• Leaves the skin radiant by improving the skin tone.
Ingredients
Lemon, Tomato, Fruit Extract , Cucumber and Turmeric.
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What does the De-Tan Kit target?
Sun tan, dullness, patchiness, and uneven skin tone.
Is it suitable for summer use?
Perfect for summer — it instantly removes tan and refreshes skin.
Does it lighten natural skin tone?
No, it only removes tan and restores your natural shade.
How quickly does it work?
You’ll see visible brightness in the first use.
Can men use it?
Absolutely — it works for all skin types and genders.

Description
Get brighter and illuminated skin with Glowelle Vitamin C 20% Face Serum. Infused with orange, lemon, and witch hazel, this lightweight formula absorbs quickly to provide a natural glow, even out skin tone and texture, and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Suitable for both men and women, this 30 ML bottle provides antioxidant protection against environmental stressors while leaving your skin feeling soft and hydrated.
How to Use
•  Apply 3-5 drops of Glowelle Vitamin C 20% Face Serum on the entire face and neck
(twice a day) in an upward circular motion.
• Massage using fingertips until the serum gets absorbed.
•  During the day, follow it up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen moisturizer.
•  Use continuously for 6 to 8 weeks for noticeable results.
Key Features
• Provides a natural glow to the skin
•Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
•Evens out skin tone and texture
•Helps reduce hyperpigmentation and dark spots
Ingredients
Orange Extract, Lemon Extract, 20% Vitamin C, Witch Hazel Extract

Description
The P2 (Papaya & Potato) Anti-Blemish DIY Kit is intended to encourage noticeably glowing skin and restore natural radiance. It gently lightens dark spots and helps prevent pigmentation thanks to the brightening power of tarbooz and papaya extracts. With consistent use, the kit promotes even skin tone, increases overall luminosity, and improves skin clarity. It provides a clear, healthy, and revitalised complexion, making it perfect for dull, uneven, and blemish-prone skin.
How to Use
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏 - 𝐂𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐞𝐫 : Cleanser Apply it to your fingertips and gently massage your face and neck for two to three minutes in a circular motion. Rinse thoroughly with water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐 - 𝐒𝐜𝐫𝐮𝐛 : Apply sufficient scrub to the face and massage gently in upward circular motions for 2–3 minutes to remove dead cells. Rinse thoroughly with water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑 - 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐆𝐞𝐥 :Take a sufficient quantity of massage gel and massage the face for 10–15 minutes for the best results. Wash off with plenty of water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒 - 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦 :Take sufficient amount to cover the face and neck area completely.Gently massage using your fingertips for 3 to 5 minutes.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟓 - 𝐅𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐏𝐚𝐜𝐤 : Apply a thick layer of pack to the face and neck.Leave for 10–15 minutes for best results, then rinse with water.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟔 - 𝐅𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐒𝐞𝐫𝐮𝐦 : Spread the serum all over your face and massage in a circular motion. The serum penetrates deep into the skin.
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟕 - 𝐄𝐲𝐞 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐤 :Apply a layer around the eye area.Leave it on for 20 minutes, wipe with moist cotton, or rinse it.
Key Features
•Formulated with Papaya & Potato extracts known for their natural skin-brightening properties
•Helps prevent pigmentation and visibly lightens dark spots
•Promotes a healthy, radiant, and glowing complexion
•Supports even skin tone and improves skin clarity
•Ideal for blemish-prone, dull, and uneven skin types
Ingredients
Papaya, potato, kheera, santara, manjishta,
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What concerns does it target?
Dark spots, blemishes, pimple marks and uneven tone.
Does it work on old marks?
Yes, regular use visibly fades old blemishes too.
Is it suitable for acne-prone skin?
Yes, papaya enzymes gently exfoliate without irritation.
When will I see results?
Usually within 2–3 uses.
Why papaya & potato?
Both are known for natural brightening and spot-lightening properties.Papaya enzymes gently exfoliate

Description
Aaryanveda 24 Carat Gold Bleach Cream is a premium-quality product designed to lighten facial hair while nourishing and rejuvenating the skin.
How to Use
•Cleanse your face with face wash and pat dry.
•Mix the Gold bleach cream and powder activator.
•Apply the mixture evenly on the face and Neck .
•Leave it for 15 minutes and then rinse it off with cold water.
Key Features
•Lightens facial hair and reduces pigmentation.
•Gives the skin a brighter and more radiant look.
•Nourishes and hydrates the skin.
•Helps in improving skin texture and tone.
•Provides a spa-like experience at home.
Ingredients
Gold Particles, Aloevera Extract
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What does 24K Gold Bleach do for the skin?
It gives an instant golden glow, boosts radiance and helps skin look youthful and refreshed.
Is it safe for bridal or party-ready skin?
Yes! It’s ideal before weddings, festivals, or any special event for a premium facial glow.
Will 24K Gold Bleach irritate my skin?
It’s gentle, but patch testing is recommended if you have super-sensitive skin.
How long do the results last?
The glow can last 7–10 days with proper skincare.
Can I use it with other skincare products?
Yes, you can follow it up with toner and moisturizer — avoid exfoliation for 24 hours.

Description
Get brighter and illuminated skin with Glowelle Vitamin C 20% Face Serum. Infused with orange, lemon, and witch hazel, this lightweight formula absorbs quickly to provide a natural glow, even out skin tone and texture, and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Suitable for both men and women, this 30 ML bottle provides antioxidant protection against environmental stressors while leaving your skin feeling soft and hydrated.
How to Use
•  Apply 3-5 drops of Glowelle Vitamin C 20% Face Serum on the entire face and neck
(twice a day) in an upward circular motion.
• Massage using fingertips until the serum gets absorbed.
•  During the day, follow it up with a broad-spectrum sunscreen moisturizer.
•  Use continuously for 6 to 8 weeks for noticeable results.
Key Features
• Provides a natural glow to the skin
•Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
•Evens out skin tone and texture
•Helps reduce hyperpigmentation and dark spots

Description
Aaryanveda Diamond Hydra Bleach Cream is a skin-lightening product that helps in removing tan and brightening the complexion. It contains diamond ash and other natural ingredients that nourish the skin.
How to Use
• Cleanse your face with face wash and pat dry.
•Mix the bleach cream and powder activator.
•Apply the mixture evenly on the face and neck.
•Leave it for 15 minutes and then rinse it off with cold water.
Key Features
•Removes tan and brightens the skin complexion.
•Contains diamond ash that provides a natural glow to the skin.
•Nourishes the skin with natural ingredients.
•Easy to use and can be done at home.
•Does not contain harmful chemicals.
Ingredients
Diamond Ash, Sweet Almond oil , Shea Butter,
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What makes Aaryanveda Diamond Bleach different?
This bleach contains Diamond Ash, known for giving the skin a natural, radiant glow and a smooth, polished finish.
How do I use the activator?
Use only one-fourth (¼) of the activator in the bleach mix.  Example: If you take 1 spoon of bleach cream, add just ¼ spoon of activator.
Is Diamond Bleach suitable for all skin types?
Yes, it is suitable for most skin types. However, people with very sensitive skin should do a patch test first.
How long should I keep the bleach on?
Keep it on for 10–12 minutes or until the desired lightening is achieved. Avoid over-processing.
Does Diamond Bleach lighten facial hair?
Yes, like all bleaches, it safely lightens facial hair to blend naturally with your skin tone.

Description
Tanend De-Tan Bleach Cream with Milk & Honey is a skin-brightening and whitening cream that helps remove tan and pigmentation, leaving the skin soft and glowing.
How to Use
• Wash your face and neck thoroughly with water and pat dry.
• Apply the Tanend Bleach cream on the face and neck and leave it on for 10-15 minutes.
• Rinse off with water and pat dry.
Key Features
• Helps remove tan and pigmentation
• Brightens and whitens the skin
• Softens and smooths the skin
• Contains natural ingredients like milk and honey that nourish the skin
• Suitable for all skin types.
Ingredients
Milk , Honey , Arbutin ,Saffron ,Turmeric
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
How long should I leave the bleach on?
Typically 10–15 minutes depending on your skin sensitivity — always follow the pack instructions.
What makes Tan End Bleach different from regular bleach?
It is specially formulated to target suntan, dullness, and uneven skin tone while being gentle on sensitive skin.
Can I use Tan End Bleach on sensitive skin?
Yes, it’s designed to be mild, but a patch test is always recommended for sensitive skin.
How long does the instant brightening effect last?
You will see results immediately, which can last 7–10 days depending on your skin type and exposure to sun.
How often should I use Tan End Bleach?
Use it once every 10-12 days for best results.

FAQs
What is Mango Bleach and what does it do?
Mango Bleach uses mango enzymes + mild brightening agents to lighten facial hair, reduce dullness, and provide glow.
Is Mango Bleach good for dry or dull skin?

Does it lighten facial hair naturally?
Yes, it gently lightens fine facial hair, giving a smooth, even-toned look without harsh chemicals.
How often can I use Mango Bleach?
Use it once every 10-12 days for consistent glow and facial hair lightening.

• Use once a 15 days for optimal results.
Key Features
• Lightens facial hair and improves skin complexion.
• Exfoliates dead skin cells and removes impurities.
• Nourishes the skin with the goodness of fruits.

What does a Fruit Bleach do?
Fruit Bleach helps brighten the skin, reduce dullness, and lighten facial hair using fruit-based enzymes.
Is Fruit Bleach safe for sensitive skin?

How often can I use Fruit Bleach?
You can use it once every 10-15 days to maintain brightness and keep facial hair looking lighter and natural.
Does Fruit Bleach actually lighten facial hair?
Yes! Fruit Bleach is designed to safely lighten fine facial hair, making it less visible and giving the skin a smoother look.
Will Fruit Bleach brighten my skin tone?
Yes, it helps remove dullness, tan, and dead skin buildup for a naturally brighter appearance.

Description
Aaryanveda Diamond Hydra Bleach Cream is a skin-lightening product that helps in removing tan and brightening the complexion. It contains diamond ash and other natural ingredients that nourish the skin.
How to Use
• Cleanse your face with face wash and pat dry.
•Mix the bleach cream and powder activator.
•Apply the mixture evenly on the face and neck.
•Leave it for 15 minutes and then rinse it off with cold water.
Key Features
•Removes tan and brightens the skin complexion.
•Contains diamond ash that provides a natural glow to the skin.
•Nourishes the skin with natural ingredients.
•Easy to use and can be done at home.
•Does not contain harmful chemicals.
Ingredients
Diamond Ash, Sweet Almond oil , Shea Butter,
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What makes Aaryanveda Diamond Bleach different?
This bleach contains Diamond Ash, known for giving the skin a natural, radiant glow and a smooth, polished finish.
How do I use the activator?
Use only one-fourth (¼) of the activator in the bleach mix.  Example: If you take 1 spoon of bleach cream, add just ¼ spoon of activator.
Is Diamond Bleach suitable for all skin types?
Yes, it is suitable for most skin types. However, people with very sensitive skin should do a patch test first.
How long should I keep the bleach on?
Keep it on for 10–12 minutes or until the desired lightening is achieved. Avoid over-processing.
Does Diamond Bleach lighten facial hair?
Yes, like all bleaches, it safely lightens facial hair to blend naturally with your skin tone.

Description
Aaryanveda Fruit Bleach Cream is a natural formula that helps to lighten facial hair and remove dead skin cells, leaving the skin feeling soft, smooth, and radiant.
How to Use
• Cleanse your face and pat dry.
• Mix 1/4 of activator in bleach cream.
• Apply a thin layer of the Fruit Bleach Cream evenly on your face and neck.
• Leave it on for 15 minutes and rinse off with cold water.
• Pat dry and apply a moisturizer for best results.
• Use once a 15 days for optimal results.
Key Features
• Lightens facial hair and improves skin complexion.
• Exfoliates dead skin cells and removes impurities.
• Nourishes the skin with the goodness of fruits.
• Prevents the appearance of wrinkles and fine lines.
• Gives a youthful and radiant glow to the skin.
Ingredients
Peach , Papaya , Apple , Kiwi
Trusted by 30 Cr+ Customers.
FAQs
What does a Fruit Bleach do?
Fruit Bleach helps brighten the skin, reduce dullness, and lighten facial hair using fruit-based enzymes.
Is Fruit Bleach safe for sensitive skin?
Yes, It  is generally gentle because of its mild fruit extracts, but a patch test is recommended.
How often can I use Fruit Bleach?
You can use it once every 10-15 days to maintain brightness and keep facial hair looking lighter and natural.
Does Fruit Bleach actually lighten facial hair?
Yes! Fruit Bleach is designed to safely lighten fine facial hair, making it less visible and giving the skin a smoother look.
Will Fruit Bleach brighten my skin tone?
Yes, it helps remove dullness, tan, and dead skin buildup for a naturally brighter appearance.

Haldi Chandan Herbal Bleach Cream

safer, smoother, more luminous
glow in minutes!
How to Use
*Perform a patch test before use
*Cleanse the face/area and pat dry
*Mix bleach cream with activator (10:1 ratio)
*Apply evenly, avoiding eyes and lips
*Leave on for 10–15 minutes (8–10 minutes for sensitive skin)
*Remove with damp cotton and rinse with water
*Apply soothing gel or moisturizer after use

What are the benefits of Haldi Chandan Bleach?
It combines the goodness of Haldi and Chandan to reduce pigmentation, calm skin and give a natural glow.
